subject: Proposed telemetry processor addition — 30-day compliance review request
messages:
From: Claire Morgan <claire@finsecure.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Atwood <ben@finsecure.com>
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed telemetry processor addition — EdgeSight Labs (30d notice)

Hi Rachel,

Hope you're well. We're planning to add a short-term telemetry processor (EdgeSight Labs) to our ingestion pipeline for a pilot with a small subset of customers. This processor will receive non-PII telemetry (service metrics + anonymized request latencies) but will sit in the transit path for a limited retention window.

We wanted to provide the 30-day notice and request your review for any data residency / DPA implications. Attached is the vendor security questionnaire and our proposed DPA edit for the new processor. Specific asks: 
- Confirmation this processor is allowed under Redwood's current DPA scope and subprocessors roster.
- Any additional evidence you need (SOC2 report, export controls, onshore fallback options).
- If you require changes to retention or redaction before we start the pilot.

We'll plan for tentative onboarding the week of June 25 pending approvals.

Attachments: [edgesight_security_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)], [vendor_dpa_draft.docx]

Thanks — let us know if you'd like a quick call.

— Claire Morgan
Head of Platform Security, FinSecure
cla ire@finsecure.com | +1 415 555 0149
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: Claire Morgan <claire@finsecure.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed telemetry processor addition — EdgeSight Labs (30d notice)

Thanks Claire — received. 

Quick acknowledgement and next steps from our side: 
1) I've looped in Kimberly (Privacy Lead) and Jordan (Legal) for a rapid review.
2) Can you confirm the exact data elements (sample payload) and the retention window in hours/days? Saying "non-PII" is helpful but we need a short schema.
3) If you have a sample export/dataflow diagram showing where EdgeSight will be inserted (ingest -> kafka -> edgesight -> storage), please attach or share a drive link.

Kimberly/Jordan — pinging you both to prioritize this as a 30-day review. If Kimberly can confirm whether this fits the current subcontractor categories (telemetry/observability) and whether an onshore fallback is required for EU accounts, that will help Claire move forward. Jordan, please flag any DPA edits in the attached draft you think we must require for onboarding.

I can coordinate a short 30-minute sync next week if helpful — I have availability Tue/Wed afternoons PT.

Best,

Rachel Kim
Security & Privacy Manager | Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>, Claire Morgan <claire@finsecure.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed telemetry processor addition — EdgeSight Labs (30d notice)

Rachel / Claire — quick internal checklist and initial callouts below. Will follow up with the evidence pack by EOD Tue.

Initial triage (telemetry / non-PII claims):
- Need concrete payload example (JSON) showing all fields; confirm no session/user identifiers, no request/response body content.
- Retention: anything >30 days requires justification for telemetry; our standard ask for pilot telemetry is <=14 days and aggregated if possible.
- Jurisdiction: if FinSecure routes EU traffic through EdgeSight in EU, we need confirmation of EU hosting + KMS jurisdiction or an onshore fallback.

Required evidence for onboarding (please provide):
- Current SOC2 Type II report or equivalent (last 12 months).
- Encryption-in-transit and at-rest descriptions, including key management (KMS location).
- Data flow diagram (simple diagram or sequence of HTTP/Kafka hops).
- Any subcontractors EdgeSight uses for storage/egress.

Attachments (to be provided): [evidence-checklist-template.pdf], [recommended-dpa-clauses.txt]

If Claire can get the sample payload + hosting region confirmation, we can usually clear pilots within the 30-day window provided retention is limited and SOC2 evidence is acceptable. Jordan — please flag if you want additional contract language; otherwise I'll draft recommended DPA clauses.

— Kimberly Park
Privacy Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Morgan <claire@finsecure.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Atwood <ben@finsecure.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed telemetry processor addition — EdgeSight Labs (30d notice)

Thanks Kimberly — attaching a small payload sample and a short dataflow sketch via Drive. Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C4d5E6F7G8H

Payload notes: fields = {service_name, timestamp_utc, route_path, response_ms, status_code}. No user_id, no full URL query params, no request/response bodies. Retention for the pilot set to 7 days, aggregated hourly. EdgeSight will store metrics in their EU cluster for EU customers; for non-EU customers storage will be in their us-central cluster. EdgeSight uses CloudKeys (third-party KMS) — we've attached their SOC2 summary and a redline DPA with suggested language.

Attachments included in Drive: edgesight_security_questionnaire.pdf, vendor_dpa_draft.docx

Happy to hop on a call if you want to walk the dataflow.

— Claire
